europe_now.title: Ukrainian Strikes Damage Crimean Bridge
europe_now.summary: Ukrainian forces launched an operation that caused a partial collapse of the Crimean Bridge, severely disrupting a critical supply route. Officials noted that the attack has significantly impaired Russian logistics in the region.

sources.headline: How the attack on Putin's prized Crimean Bridge unfolded
Crimean Bridge partly collapses as Zelensky hails 'unprecedented' attack by Ukraine

europe_now.title: Nationwide Public Sector Strikes in France
europe_now.summary: France is experiencing fresh nationwide public sector strikes amid ongoing political debates over retirement reforms and labor conditions. Unions and the government remain at a stalemate as demonstrations continue across the country.

sources.headline: France hit by fresh nationwide public sector strike

top_stories.title: Infrastructure Attacks in Eastern Europe
top_stories.summary: Recent military strikes have targeted key infrastructure, including bridges in Ukraine and Kyiv, leading to disruptions in essential services. President Zelenskyy provided operational details regarding the assault on the Crimean Bridge.

sources.headline: Ukraine: Two bridges in Kyiv heavily damaged by Russian strikes
Zelenskyy gives details on Ukraine’s Crimea bridge operation

top_stories.title: French Political Campaign and Labor Unrest
top_stories.summary: French political figures are actively debating economic and pension policies as presidential campaigns intensify alongside public sector strikes. Far-right candidate Marine Le Pen has publicly pledged to roll back existing pension legislation if elected.

sources.headline: French far-right candidate Le Pen vows to end Macron's pension reform if elected

top_stories.summary: The European Commission has frozen millions in recovery funds for Slovakia over governance and policy concerns linked to a former minister. Additionally, regulatory pressure continues on international platforms regarding compliance and product safety standards.
